title: Toss Strange Coins
summary: Given a set of coins where the probability of the i-th coin landing heads is specified in the array prob, calculate the probability that exactly target coins will land heads when each coin is tossed exactly once.
statement: Given a set of coins where the probability of the i-th coin landing heads is specified in the array prob, calculate the probability that exactly target coins will land heads when each coin is tossed exactly once.
constraints: Coins are independent and coin i lands heads with probability prob[i].
Return the probability that exactly target coins land heads.
hints: Track probabilities by exact head count after each processed coin.
A state keeps its head count on tails or gains one on heads.
Update counts downward so the previous row is not overwritten.
The last coin is uniquely heads or tails, making the two probability contributions disjoint and exhaustive.
